lines.zh: 巨鱼在水下缓缓摆尾
lines.en: The giant fish swings its tail slowly.

lines.zh: 它的背鳍划开绿色的水
lines.en: Its dorsal fin cuts the green water.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼被它带得散开
lines.en: A shoal of small fish scatters around it.

lines.zh: 它贴着海床巡游
lines.en: It cruises low along the seabed.

lines.zh: 鳍边的水纹一圈圈散出去
lines.en: Ripples spread from the edge of its fins.

lines.zh: 它忽然侧身，拐了个大弯
lines.en: It banks suddenly in a wide turn.

lines.zh: 身体比你的船还长
lines.en: Its body is longer than your boat.

lines.zh: 它从海草上方滑过去
lines.en: It glides over the seagrass.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，就是好几格远
lines.en: One tailbeat carries it several blocks.

lines.zh: 它沿着浅滩慢慢游
lines.en: It swims slowly along the shallows.

lines.zh: 它的动作看不出一点费力
lines.en: Its movement looks entirely effortless.

lines.zh: 阴影从水底一路移过去
lines.en: A shadow slides across the seabed.

lines.zh: 它转向上层水域，速度加快
lines.en: It turns for higher water and speeds up.

lines.zh: 它的嘴一张一合，在滤水
lines.en: Its mouth opens and closes, sifting water.

lines.zh: 它绕过珊瑚，没有碰坏一枝
lines.en: It rounds the coral without breaking a branch.

lines.zh: 水面被它顶出一道波纹
lines.en: The surface bulges in a long ripple.

lines.zh: 巨鱼停在水里，鳍轻轻摆
lines.en: It hangs in the water, fins barely moving.

lines.zh: 它悬停在岩缝上方
lines.en: It hovers over a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 一只海龟从它身边游过
lines.en: A turtle paddles past it.

lines.zh: 它的鳃盖一下一下地开合
lines.en: Its gill covers open and close.

lines.zh: 光斑在它背上晃动
lines.en: Light shifts across its back.

lines.zh: 它盯着沙里的一处小动静
lines.en: It stares at a small stirring in the sand.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛大得有点不真实
lines.en: Its eyes are uncannily large.

lines.zh: 一串气泡从它嘴边升上水面
lines.en: A string of bubbles rises from its mouth.

lines.zh: 它慢慢漂着，像睡着了
lines.en: It drifts as if asleep.

lines.zh: 它突然抖了下鳍，尘埃散开
lines.en: A flick of its fin clears the silt.

lines.zh: 它把自己藏在礁石阴影里
lines.en: It tucks itself into the reef's shadow.

lines.zh: 水面在它头顶聚起一片光
lines.en: A pool of light gathers overhead.

lines.zh: 它偶尔张一下嘴，又闭上
lines.en: Now and then its jaw opens and shuts.

lines.zh: 鳞片上的光一层层暗下去
lines.en: The sheen on its scales dims by layers.

lines.zh: 巨鱼转过身，正对着你
lines.en: The giant fish turns to face you.

lines.zh: 那只大眼一动不动
lines.en: One enormous eye holds still.

lines.zh: 它绕着你游了小半圈
lines.en: It swims a slow half circle around you.

lines.zh: 它似乎把你当成礁石
lines.en: It seems to take you for a rock.

lines.zh: 它凑近，鼻孔几乎碰到你
lines.en: It comes close, snout nearly touching.

lines.zh: 你在它眼里小得可笑
lines.en: You look absurdly small to it.

lines.zh: 它张开嘴，又慢慢合上
lines.en: It opens its mouth, then closes it.

lines.zh: 它的影子盖住了你
lines.en: Its shadow passes over you.

lines.zh: 它对你的气泡很感兴趣
lines.en: Your bubbles interest it more than you do.

lines.zh: 它悬在那儿，像在判断
lines.en: It hangs there, judging.

lines.zh: 巨鱼猛地一甩尾，退开了
lines.en: A hard tailbeat carries it away.

lines.zh: 它侧翻了一下又稳住
lines.en: It rolls partly over and rights itself.

lines.zh: 伤口涌出的血在水里散开
lines.en: Blood from the wound clouds the water.

lines.zh: 它张嘴，发出低沉的震动
lines.en: It opens its mouth in a low thrum.

lines.zh: 它绕着你转，不敢再冲
lines.en: It circles, no longer rushing in.

lines.zh: 鳞片少了一片，露出白肉
lines.en: A scale is gone, showing pale flesh.

lines.zh: 它躲进礁石的阴影里
lines.en: It retreats into the reef's shadow.

lines.zh: 它的呼吸变得急促
lines.en: Its gill rhythm turns rapid.

lines.zh: 它撞到了海床，扬起泥沙
lines.en: It scrapes the seabed, raising silt.

lines.zh: 它受伤后游得没那么稳了
lines.en: Wounded, its swimming loses its poise.

lines.zh: 巨鱼朝血水的味道游来
lines.en: The giant fish comes for the scent of blood.

lines.zh: 它缓缓张开大嘴
lines.en: Its great mouth opens slowly.

lines.zh: 它把食物和你的手一起看
lines.en: It eyes the food and your hand alike.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，它冲近了
lines.en: A tailbeat and it surges near.

lines.zh: 它绕着食物打转，先不吃
lines.en: It circles the food before taking it.

lines.zh: 一口吞下，水都晃了一下
lines.en: One gulp makes the water lurch.

lines.zh: 它又回到你面前，等更多
lines.en: It returns to your side wanting more.

lines.zh: 它的嘴唇擦过你的手臂
lines.en: Its lips rasp against your arm.

lines.zh: 它吞得太多，动作变沉了
lines.en: Overfed, its movement turns heavy.

lines.zh: 它盯着你，像在打量下一口
lines.en: It watches you like the next mouthful.

lines.zh: 巨鱼的身体撞上你，很沉
lines.en: Its body strikes you, heavy and slow.

lines.zh: 你被水流推得转了个身
lines.en: The current rolls you right around.

lines.zh: 它的侧鳍扫过你的腰
lines.en: A pectoral fin sweeps your waist.

lines.zh: 它侧身让路，鳍差点打到
lines.en: It yields the way, fin nearly clipping you.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴拍水，把你掀开
lines.en: One tail sweep shoves you aside.

lines.zh: 它撞完继续游，像没发生
lines.en: It swims on as if nothing happened.

lines.zh: 你被它的躯体挤到礁石上
lines.en: Its bulk presses you to the reef.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼趁乱擦过你
lines.en: Small fish rush past in the confusion.

lines.zh: 它退开一点，给你留出空
lines.en: It pulls back to give you room.

lines.zh: 水下的一撞比岸上更闷
lines.en: Underwater impacts land duller.

lines.zh: 两条巨鱼并肩逆流游动
lines.en: Two giants swim side by side upstream.

lines.zh: 它的鳍轻轻贴上伴侣的侧腹
lines.en: A fin rests against its partner's flank.

lines.zh: 它们绕着彼此画着大圈
lines.en: They trace great circles around each other.

lines.zh: 它们尾鳍同步摆动
lines.en: Their tails beat in time.

lines.zh: 它把最好的水域让给对方
lines.en: It yields the best water to its mate.

lines.zh: 它们贴着游过礁石的缺口
lines.en: They slip through a gap in the reef together.

lines.zh: 水压变化时它们一起转向
lines.en: They turn as one when the current shifts.

lines.zh: 两条影子在水底叠成一条
lines.en: Two shadows merge on the seabed.

lines.zh: 它们互相轻碰口部
lines.en: They touch mouths gently.

lines.zh: 这片海暂时安静下来
lines.en: The sea goes quiet around them.

lines.zh: 巨鱼一口吸进了食物
lines.en: The giant fish inhales the food.

lines.zh: 它张嘴，水流把东西卷进去
lines.en: Its mouth opens; current carries it in.

lines.zh: 它把掉落的肉含在齿间
lines.en: It holds the fallen meat between teeth.

lines.zh: 它嗅了嗅，才决定吞下
lines.en: It sniffs, then decides to swallow.

lines.zh: 它一口吞掉整条鱼
lines.en: It swallows a whole fish at once.

lines.zh: 它把不吃的吐出来
lines.en: What it does not want, it spits out.

lines.zh: 它的嘴一张，东西就消失了
lines.en: The mouth opens and the thing is gone.

lines.zh: 它吃到沉在海底的碎屑
lines.en: It vacuums crumbs off the seabed.

lines.zh: 吃完它慢慢摆尾离开
lines.en: Fed, it swims off with a slow tailbeat.

lines.zh: 它回头看了一眼食点
lines.en: It glances back at the feeding spot.

lines.zh: 巨鱼的身体忽然绷紧
lines.en: The giant fish stiffens all at once.

lines.zh: 它把方向对准了你
lines.en: It lines itself up on you.

lines.zh: 大嘴张开的阴影压过来
lines.en: The shadow of its open mouth nears.

lines.zh: 它开始加速，鳍向后掠
lines.en: It accelerates, fins swept back.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛缩紧了一下
lines.en: Its eyes tighten.

lines.zh: 它绕到你背后，断了退路
lines.en: It slides behind you, cutting retreat.

lines.zh: 一次试探的突进
lines.en: One probing lunge.

lines.zh: 它认定你是可吃的东西
lines.en: It has decided you are edible.

lines.zh: 水里的压力都在往它那边走
lines.en: The water pressure pulls toward it.

lines.zh: 它把路封住了
lines.en: It has closed the way out.

lines.zh: 巨鱼在你身边打转
lines.en: The giant fish circles you.

lines.zh: 它一圈比一圈靠近
lines.en: Each circle comes tighter.

lines.zh: 它用侧线感知你的动静
lines.en: It reads your motion along its flank.

lines.zh: 它正对着你，慢慢逼近
lines.en: It faces you and closes slowly.

lines.zh: 它突然转向，换个角度
lines.en: It veers to take another angle.

lines.zh: 尾巴轻轻摆动，蓄着力
lines.en: Its tail sways, storing power.

lines.zh: 它把你赶向更深的水
lines.en: It herds you toward deeper water.

lines.zh: 它每绕一圈都更近一点
lines.en: Every pass ends nearer.

lines.zh: 它盯着你的手脚，不看别处
lines.en: It watches your limbs, nothing else.

lines.zh: 忽然停住，是为了突进
lines.en: The sudden stop is a windup.

lines.zh: 巨鱼一头撞在你的胸口
lines.en: The giant fish rams your chest.

lines.zh: 它张口一咬，牙齿刮过肋骨
lines.en: Its bite rakes past your ribs.

lines.zh: 它侧身一撕，你被甩开
lines.en: A sideways tear throws you clear.

lines.zh: 尾巴拍过来，水也跟着砸
lines.en: Its tail lashes, water crashing with it.

lines.zh: 它咬住你的护甲用力甩头
lines.en: It bites your armour and wrenches its head.

lines.zh: 它突进后再退，重新瞄准
lines.en: It lunges, withdraws, re-aims.

lines.zh: 一口咬空，上下颚砰地合上
lines.en: Jaws snap shut on nothing.

lines.zh: 它的体重压过来，你动不了
lines.en: Its mass pins you in place.

lines.zh: 它用吻部把你顶向岩壁
lines.en: Its snout drives you into the rock.

lines.zh: 这一次它咬得更准
lines.en: This time the bite lands true.

lines.zh: 水面忽然涌起一圈波纹
lines.en: A ring of ripples breaks the surface.

lines.zh: 一个巨大的影子从深处升起
lines.en: A huge shadow rises from below.

lines.zh: 巨鱼从海草后游出来
lines.en: The giant fish emerges past the seagrass.

lines.zh: 小鱼群先一步逃开
lines.en: The small fish flee ahead of it.

lines.zh: 它的背鳍先破开水面
lines.en: Its dorsal fin breaks the surface first.

lines.zh: 一声水下的闷响传过来
lines.en: A dull underwater boom rolls past.

lines.zh: 它把海底的沙搅起一片
lines.en: It stirs a cloud of sand off the floor.

lines.zh: 它绕过珊瑚礁，进入浅水
lines.en: It rounds the reef into shallower water.

lines.zh: 它的鳞在光里泛出淡金
lines.en: Its scales flash pale gold in the light.

lines.zh: 它停在水草边，看向这边
lines.en: It stops by the weeds and looks this way.

lines.zh: 水都烫了，它疯狂地摆尾
lines.en: The water scalds; its tail thrashes wildly.

lines.zh: 摔在硬地上，它拍着鳍乱弹
lines.en: Dropped on hard ground, it flops and slaps.

lines.zh: 它在空气里张口，鳃拼命张合
lines.en: Out of water its gills work desperately.

lines.zh: 冲击在水里拧了它一个圈
lines.en: The blast spins it through the water.

lines.zh: 箭射进侧腹，它猛地一窜
lines.en: An arrow strikes its flank; it bolts.

lines.zh: 魔法灌进来，它浑身发麻
lines.en: Magic floods in and numbs it all over.

lines.zh: 饿得瘦了，它游得像纸片
lines.en: Starved thin, it swims like a sheet of paper.

lines.zh: 电流顺着水包住它，它僵住
lines.en: Current wraps through the water; it locks up.

lines.zh: 虚空抽走水流，它无助地翻腾
lines.en: The void drains the water; it flails helplessly.
